access_boundary: Only assigned original questions and literal delivered C0/C1 packs. No full sources, omitted passages, or benchmark answer fields.
scope: Audit whether additional C1 passages clarify or correct bindings of question-relevant C0 source claims.
target_correction: The parked query-frame diagnostic does not directly test extracted source-claim revision.
positive_rule: A literal question-relevant C0 claim receives additional evidence establishing or correcting entity, time, scope, relation, or value binding.
negative_rule: An added answer fact, repeated binding, unrelated clarification, or unresolved contradiction is not a clear mechanism witness.
offset_convention: Zero-based Unicode code-point offsets; ends exclusive; SHA256 over UTF-8 text.
selection_policy: All20 assigned questions retained. Every delivered unit inspected. Listed traces document the closest local possibilities.
limitations: No model output was generated or inspected.
A missing clear witness does not prove that models cannot make interpretation errors.
This is a capped development audit of these delivered packs.
The audit does not establish corpus-wide absence or statistical prevalence.
Additional full-source context might change a decision, but was outside the frozen evidence boundary.
The uncertain cases need independent review before any mechanism-pilot admission.
